American Education and Translation Services offers a wide range of translation services, including Boston international credential evaluation services. This type of evaluation compares your academic accomplishments to standards in the U.S. With this clarification, employers, schools, licensing boards, etc. can better understand your educational background.

What Do Our Credential Evaluation Services Include?

By choosing American Education and Translation Services, you can expect professional, accurate translations accepted by all organizations, agencies and institutions. When requesting our international credential evaluation services in Boston MA, you will get:

  • Identify and describe your credentials
  • Verify that your credentials are authentic
  • Can include a grade point average (GPA) equivalency
  • Evaluation of authenticity

Once you have these Boston international credential evaluation services completed, you can use the documents when furthering your education, applying for immigration, seeking employment and other things.

Why Choose Our International Credential Evaluation Services in Boston MA

Every year, our agency completes thousands of evaluation and translations. As a whole, we are capable of over 100 languages, and each one of our evaluators knows at least one foreign language. With our background and expertise, you can expect accurate, professional evaluation and translations every time you use our services.

  • ATA member. We are a member of the American Translators Association and have been since 2009. This ensures we meet a high standard of quality translation services.

Whether you intend to further your education, apply for a new work position or start the immigration process, our Boston international credential evaluation services can help. Contact American Education and Translation Services today for a free estimate.
